subject.title: fix(sweep): allow PR review lease comments

question: Should this PR receive an explicit proof override and deploy with a monitored first-run canary, or remain unmerged until real App-token comment proof is available?
rationale: The code change is correct, but only a maintainer can authorize the widened pull-request write scope and waive the external-PR requirement for pre-merge real-behavior proof when that proof depends on the default-branch deployment.

options.title: Approve monitored rollout
options.body: Explicitly accept the scoped token increase, merge with a proof override, and require redacted pull-request and issue comment evidence from the first normal post-deployment run.

options.title: Hold for live proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until staging, shadow deployment, or another maintainer-controlled environment demonstrates both comment paths with a real App token.

recommendation.title: Approve monitored rollout
recommendation.body: Explicitly accept the scoped token increase, merge with a proof override, and require redacted pull-request and issue comment evidence from the first normal post-deployment run.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is authorization of a GitHub App security boundary and production rollout policy rather than a code repair.
